ways.label: Remarkables ski field to Lake Alta

start.name: road behind the Remarkables ski field buildings
start.quote: road behind the Remarkables ski field buildings

evidence: The track begins on the road behind the Remarkables ski field buildings and follows a ski field road to the top of the Alta Chairlift.
From there, cairns and flagstones mark the way through alpine wetlands, up to the glacial cirque.

doubts: Start ref F1 (an unnamed track meeting the Remarkables Ski Field Access Road) is the only road end listed and matches 'begins on the road behind the Remarkables ski field buildings', but the feature is unnamed so this is not certain. The listed lift ends (1865 m and 1933 m) do not clearly match the 'top of the Alta Chairlift' (the track runs 1600-1800 m), so no ref for it. In winter the route through the ski field differs and must be checked with NZSki; not recorded as a way.
